# Nuevo Automations

> Nuevo Automations (Nuevo Automations FZE LLC) is a marketing agency registered in Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone, United Arab Emirates, founded by Nawaf Allahham. It runs Meta (Instagram and Facebook) click-to-WhatsApp ads for UAE businesses and sells M2S (Message to Sale): an AI sales assistant that replies on WhatsApp in English or Arabic, closes the sale in the chat, follows up on abandoned carts, unpaid payment links and quiet leads, and sends a monthly results report.

Key facts:
- Serves businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates), in English and Arabic.
- M2S runs on the client's own WhatsApp number and on OrcaFlo, a WhatsApp AI platform Nuevo Automations built and runs itself.
- The AI never invents prices or products; anything it can't answer is handed to the client's team with a chat summary.
- Pricing: one fixed monthly fee, quoted in writing after a free 20-minute audit. No public price list. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and is not part of the fee.
- No guaranteed results. Partners report 50–60% more revenue from the same traffic after full rollout; individual results vary.
- Licence no. 4431808.01. Contact: WhatsApp +971 50 854 9171, nawafallahham@nuevoautomations.com.
